summary: Homepage presents a software-building coding agent, interactive workflow demonstrations and start/download actions.
Pricing page exposes a free entry alongside individual, team and enterprise choices and a contact-sales route. Rates and features are a dated snapshot.
Community hub invites participation in meetups, cafes, hackathons and workshops. Curated embedded posts show examples of local events.
Vendor-published National Australia Bank story describes adoption and workflow outcomes at a named enterprise. It is not independently verified causal evidence.
Customer topic archive links repeated named-company stories and concrete workflows.
Robots permits general public crawling and restricts various application, settings and documentation paths.
Public XML sitemap lists product and content pages.
Public llms text resource links and describes product information.

Brief assumptions: hypothetical prelaunch founder in the competitor category, no audience or marketing budget, no live product URL. No paid keys, logins, contact or ad-library audit. No systematic founder/social/Reddit/launch check or numeric search-volume measurement. Strength scores are analyst evidence ratings, not traffic estimates. Proposed playbook counts are experiments, not observed competitor performance. Full homepage archive unavailable.

title: Sitemap: 47,562 URLs, 5 programmatic page families, 137 content updates in 90d
interpretation: Counts are collected sitemap URLs and lastmod signals, not verified Google indexation or editorial publication dates.

title: Hacker News: 260 submissions, best 658 points
interpretation: Domain-search sample includes submissions and discussion, not only official launches; brand relevance and customer conversion not established.

title: Ad/attribution pixels: Meta Pixel, Google Ads conversion tag, TikTok Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, Reddit Pixel, Snap Pixel, Google Floodlight / DV360
interpretation: Tag detection shows instrumentation, not live ads or spend.

title: Homepage history: first archived 1996-11-01, 180 monthly snapshots
interpretation: Snapshot availability is not evidence of historical page copy; old domain ownership may differ.
